messages:
kai_ops: Heads-up: planning a brief maintenance in eu-central-2 this Fri 00:30-01:30 UTC. Goal: staggered GPU driver soft-reloads to mitigate recent heat-induced throttles.

mika_infra: Sequence? We should avoid doing more than 2 racks in parallel; last heat spike correlated with 4 simultaneous restarts.

kai_ops: Agreed. Cadence = 2 racks every 8 minutes, pre-warm KV cache and throttle egress for 10m around each rack.

jon_sre: Abort criteria: p95 gen latency +120ms, error rate +5% sustained 10m, or node temp >85C. If hit, shift remaining racks to eu-west-1 standby and halt.

elaine_prod: I'll move realtime tenants to dedicated-standby for the hour. ETA sheet updated.

finance-bot: Cost estimate: warm-standby backfill ~+0.3% daily spend if we use reserved nodes; alert set at +0.7%.

kai_ops: Commands for on-call:
```
kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
ssh $NODE sudo systemctl stop nvidia-persistenced || true
ssh $NODE sudo modprobe -r nvidia_uvm nvidia || true
ssh $NODE sudo reboot || sudo /sbin/shutdown -r now
kubectl uncordon $NODE
```

mika_infra: Telemetry probe added: post-uncordon smoke gen (size 128) + temp check. I'll be on the run.

jon_sre: I'll monitor dashboards and escalate if thresholds breach.

kai_ops: Thanks all. Maintenance ticket m-euc2-2026-04-09 scheduled. Postmortem thread will be auto-created. :thumbsup:
